note: Kentucky State Parks campground on an upland beside the park golf course, set back from Grayson Lake, which is reached by trail. The loops are open and grassy with scattered pines. Some sites slope and need levelling. The check-in station sells ice, drinks and firewood. --Claude
summary: Kept. 69 Standard Electric sites (50/30/20A + water at the site per RA; no sewer), 32-69 ft back-ins plus two 112-ft pull-throughs; $30 Sun-Thu / $34 Fri-Sat / $38 holiday; two service buildings with restrooms, showers, laundry; dump. Season Mar 15 - Nov 15. Not waterfront confirmed. Water at the site true (stored false). Count 71 -> 69. Website fix; policy copies cleared.
